exposure: period between onset of seizures to arrival at hospital
cohort: Women with eclampsia presenting to Lagos State University Teaching Hospital (LASUTH), Nigeria, between January 1, 2011 and December 31, 2012.
finding: Maternal mortality in eclampsia patients was independently associated with a delay of >12 hours between seizure onset and hospital arrival, vaginal delivery, aspiration pneumonitis, and renal failure, while magnesium sulfate use was protective.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was independently associated with increased risk of maternal mortality in women with eclampsia.
